candidate_grammar.boundary: All exact finite geometric-dilution relations for one conserved localized source over complete equivalent boundaries generated from the forced rank-two spatial boundary.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the complete product of source identity, conservation, boundary rank, boundary coverage, scale transport, response allocation, falloff profile, generality, measurement direction, evidence record and extra-rule forms.

excluded_inputs: measured exponent, fitted coefficient or conventional inverse-square premise
partial boundary, omitted response row or preferred cell
semantic numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof value
target access before the forced profile seal
intended_certificate: Independent regeneration of every 4,096 form, exact source conservation and the sole rank-two inverse-square profile.
statement: For one conserved source distributed without preference over every equivalent cell of the forced rank-two boundary, increasing source distance by an exact positive ratio r increases complete boundary support by r paired with r and therefore forces response per cell to be the source divided by r squared. The exponent is derived before and independently of measurement.
title: Inverse-square dilution from rank-two boundary support
